scope: Phase 10B macOS pointer movement and left/right button delivery discovery using a test-owned AppKit fixture

discoveryBoundary.goal: Establish whether Quartz-posted mouse move and left/right button events are physically delivered and independently observable before any public pointer contract is fixed.

fixture.type: temporary borderless AppKit window with custom NSView mouse event counters
fixture.leftButton: down/up delivered only at fixture center
fixture.rightButton: down/up delivered only at fixture center

deliveryEvidence.pointerMove: Quartz CGEvent post followed by independent CGEvent current-location observation

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment prevents the controlled fixture from running before delivery can be established.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Move/button delivery, fixture observation, or required pointer restoration is not observed exactly as specified.
resultPolicy.PASS: Pointer movement is observed at the target, left/right down/up are observed by the test-owned fixture, the cursor is restored, and no semantic consequence is claimed.

nextStepOnPass: Use the physical delivery evidence to define a narrow public Phase 10B pointer contract that distinguishes verified movement from button delivery and keeps semantic UI operations preferred.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not introduce or promote a public pointer API from this checkpoint.
